resources.title: Urban Street 04
resources.sourceDescription: Unclipped, free 20K HDRI of a sunlit London street (morning/afternoon): high-contrast natural light, partly cloudy sky, building facades.
resources.changes: Exact official 1K HDR download, renamed locally. No resampling, recolouring, cropping or pixel edits. Runtime PMREM filtering and lighting calibration are separate derived rendering steps.
resources.projectUse: Image-based lighting and reflections only. Not a visible panorama background, mapped Kyoto surroundings, facade texture, or geometry source.
resources.rotationCalibration: Unregistered source orientation. Runtime yaw/intensity/exposure are authored in rig.json; no Kyoto cardinal alignment or measured illuminance is implied.

resources.title: Modern Buildings Night
resources.sourceDescription: Free 16K unclipped HDRI of a Berlin riverside at night, high-contrast artificial lights, warm glass interiors and cool blue sky reflecting on water.
